scope: Full cached development evidence, not untouched confirmation. No next experiment started.

rows.finding: Score/readout interaction is real, especially in bank12. Raw logits restore most near-max losses, but do not beat the original PB result.
rows.evidence: RBM12 PB27.5159 to36.3998 with near-max; original36.3750. Primary delta+0.0247pp,97.5%CI[-1.2677,1.3213]. Within-answer AUC+.010079,CI[.007569,.012683]. PRMScore falls .629276 to .624156.
rows.recommendation: Keep RBM6 posterior/max reference. Use bank12 logit as a candidate score interface, not a universal promoted winner. Preserve both fixed readouts.
rows.alternative: Sigmoid changes top10 aggregation as well as near-max distances; correcting a harmful interface is not a new PB gain.

rows.finding: Training has substantial value with the same logit readout. Earlier posterior comparisons hid this dependence.
rows.evidence: Logit/max initial to trained PB: bank6 21.7316 to34.9708; bank12 20.1812 to36.2712. Within-answer AUC improves .029540/.056100. Posterior/max initial remains a much stronger comparator.
rows.recommendation: Do not discard learned weights or switch to CD based on initialization comparisons across different score interfaces.
rows.alternative: This does not show an overall gain over the best initial posterior or over IU-PCR; training benefit is readout-specific.

rows.finding: Prior matched feature reliability switches between early/late positions; new bank12 logits now provide a less compressed interface.
rows.evidence: Prior chosen-surprisal minus entropy AUC: early-.1061,late+.04236 on1672 same answers; interaction95%CI[.12459,.17245]. New RBM12 versus Var15/IU with near-max has no clear PB or within-AUC advantage.
rows.recommendation: Discuss one position-conditioned bank12 fusion versus fixed weights. Prefer logit/max as the mechanism-isolation control and keep the frozen near-max path as a secondary readout. Define a proper answer-local label-free objective and shrinkage before implementation. Include Var15/IU and Varentropy controls.
rows.alternative: The feature-reliability interaction is diagnostic, not a measured adaptive-fusion gain; coverage is conditional and labels were used only to diagnose.

rows.finding: Residual/variance/serial structure exists but is not sufficient task-linked evidence for more model capacity.
rows.evidence: Prior bank6 residual excess on PB hits .34677 versus misses .34652. Error-step variance often lower, geometric entropy variance ratio about.447 on4030 eligible PRMB answers. Lag1 residual excess .1571/.1366, but coarse strata do not establish causal onset information.
rows.recommendation: Defer CD, extra units/layers, separate class variance and sequence-model sweeps. Do not alter DUFS.
rows.alternative: Better likelihood or less residual correlation can model harmless feature dependence without improving localization.
